metadata.venue: 2022 IEEE 20th Jubilee International Symposium on Intelligent Systems and Informatics (SISY)

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it focuses on a discretized three-class math proficiency outcome derived from the PISA 2012 overall mathematics result.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses a flat model for prediction without accounting for school clustering, as it analyzes individual student records directly.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through a train/test split and does not validate findings on an external dataset.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “The original training dataset was based on the publicly released PISA 2012 computer-based database.” “The goal of this research was to compare the effect … on the math proficiency prediction in PISA 2012 dataset.”
design_fields._q2_audit: Source checked; original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in the analysis.
